gloss: in other words; to put it another way; that is to say

definitions.gloss: in other words; to put it another way; that is to say
definitions.explanation: A sentence connector used to rephrase or restate what was just said in different words.

examples.japanese: {言|い}い{換|か}えると、{賛成|さんせい}ということだ。
examples.english: In other words, it means you agree.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}は{怠|なま}けている。{言|い}い{換|か}えると、やる{気|き}がない。
examples.english: He's being lazy. In other words, he has no motivation.

examples.japanese: この{計画|けいかく}は{非現実的|ひげんじつてき}だ。{言|い}い{換|か}えると、{実行|じっこう}するのは{不可能|ふかのう}に{近|ちか}い。
examples.english: This plan is unrealistic. To put it another way, carrying it out is nearly impossible.

notes:
A sentence connector used to rephrase or clarify what was just said. Literally "if one rephrases it" — from {言|い}い{換|か}える (to rephrase) + と (if/when). Typically placed at the beginning of a sentence.

VARIATIONS:
- {言|い}い{換|か}えると: standard form
- {言|い}い{換|か}えれば: slightly more formal/literary
- {言|い}い{換|か}えるなら: "if I were to rephrase"

SIMILAR EXPRESSIONS:
- つまり: in short; that is — the most common equivalent, slightly more casual
- すなわち: namely; that is — more formal and literary
- {要|よう}するに: in essence; the point is — summarizes rather than rephrases
